note: City of Ackley park (101 acres of woods and prairie, six fishing ponds, three miles of trails, disc golf), a quarter mile from downtown; the campground is in the south part of the park, mostly across a creek bridge. Monthly and seasonal stays are also sold. --Claude
summary: Rate left unset: the city's website has no park page, the heritage-area $15/$8 is undated, and campers paid $25 in June 2026. Ponds: the six fishing ponds are in the north half of the park, ~250 m+ from the campground across prairie; the two visible near the trails are ~3.5 and ~8 acres, so not waterfront confirmed. Pads: gravel rows with parked rigs visible on NAIP. Cleared directory-only site count, hookups, season and dump; confirmed showers and call-ahead booking.
flags: PRICE (not written): the City of Ackley has a website (ackleyiowa.net) but no page for the park or campground, so the operator does have a web page and the camper-report rule (operator with NO web page) does not apply as written. The Silos & Smokestacks heritage-area listing gives 'RV Camping $15, Primitive $8. Monthly/seasonal camping rates available.' with no date; RV Life campers paid $25 a night twice in June 2026 ($18 in 5/2023). Fees left as stored (no rate). If AWH counts a city site with no park page as 'no web page', write fees $25/$25 USD as CAMPER-REPORTED RATE (June 2026).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. NAIP shows the campground in the south half of the park (rows of RVs on gravel spurs around 42.5595-42.5610, -93.0620 to -93.0560). The ponds lie in the north half: the irregular pond with islands at the top of the frame is ~280 x 125 m (~8 acres) and the one east of it ~190 x 75 m (~3.5 acres), both ~250-400 m from the nearest sites across prairie and trails. A creek runs through the campground (campers cross a bridge to most sites); it is narrow, well under 30 m. The square pond south-west of the campground is outside the park (looks like a treatment lagoon).

PADS / FIT: NAIP shows gravel back-in rows with parked trailers and motorhomes along the west drive and in the centre of the campground. An RV Life camper fit a 40-ft motorhome (5/2023); a 23-ft motorhome fits.

LONG-STAY (city park, so the private five tests do not apply; for information): 'Monthly/seasonal camping rates available' (heritage-area listing). The south-centre cluster on NAIP has rigs with decks and sheds, which looks seasonal, but campers in 2026 found nightly sites.
PIN: stored 42.56050,-93.05900 sits inside the campground on NAIP; Google's 'Prairie Bridges Park' pin (42.56357,-93.05946) is the north part of the park. No change.
